summary_md:
**Institute of Foundation Models ([@IFM_AI](https://x.com/IFM_AI/status/2115488770992546100))** announces **K2 Horizon** GGUF weights for llama.cpp and Ollama in sizes from 0.9B up to MoVA-36B, fully local with no cloud API.

In the [follow-up](https://x.com/IFM_AI/status/2115488772020138164), IFM offers a deployment **skill** you hand to a coding agent: it picks a size for your machine, installs llama.cpp, pulls official weights, and leaves an OpenAI-compatible API running.

referenced_urls.title: K2 Horizon GGUF - a IFM Collection

relevance: A new open family with a ~32–36B option sized for a Spark, plus an agent skill that automates local deployment.

media.description: K2 Horizon announcement graphic: the K2 Horizon wordmark with five size chips (0.9B, 3.7B, 7B, 32B, MoVA-36B) and install commands for llama.cpp and Ollama over a topographic background.
media.ocr_text:
K2 Horizon
RUNS LOCALLY AT FIVE SIZES: 0.9B · 3.7B · 7B · 32B · MoVA-36B
llama.cpp: $ llama-cli -hf IFM/K2-Horizon-<size>-GGUF
Ollama: $ ollama run ifm/k2-horizon
